title: helichrysum retortum
intro: Helichrysum retortum, commonly known as the Retort Daisy, is a flowering plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is native to South Africa and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, making it a sought-after remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Helichrysum retortum, such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, which include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
